units.source_text: 告示牌上写的，显然是有关金阁的注意事项。

en.t: What was written on the sign was clearly a set of warnings concerning the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 可是上面的抽象语句，说不定是在暗示着什么呢。

en.t: Yet the abstract phrases on it may perhaps have been hinting at something.

units.source_text: 我只觉得不变不坏的金阉同它毫不相干，此类告示牌应立在别处。

en.t: I only felt that the unchanging, undecaying Golden Pavilion had nothing whatever to do with it, and that signs of this sort ought to be set up somewhere else.

units.source_text: 也许这告示牌公估计到将出现不可理解的行为，或者不可能的行为。

en.t: Perhaps this sign had officially reckoned with the appearance of some incomprehensible act, or even an impossible one.

units.source_text: 立法者一定是为了概括这种行为而不知所措。

en.t: The lawmakers must have been at a loss as they tried to define such an act in general terms.

units.source_text: 为了要处罚非狂人无法策划的行为，事前应该如何恫吓狂人呢？

en.t: In order to punish an act that only a madman could devise, how was one supposed to intimidate madmen in advance?

units.source_text: 大概需要写些只有狂人才能读明白的文字吧……

en.t: Probably one would have to write words that only madmen could read and understand...
